task: Fix issue #3584 by promoting quality-auditor to shared agent surfaces so routed installs can invoke it.

events.content: Measured issue #3584 on current main. Only .claude/agents carried quality-auditor while orchestrator rows already named it in install surfaces.
Added shared, GitHub, src/claude, Copilot CLI, and VS Code quality-auditor surfaces, then regenerated agent outputs and the catalog.
Added 15 reachability tests covering the five missing surfaces and the existing orchestrator route rows.
Revert check in sibling worktree ai-agents-3584-revert restored the five new agent surfaces to origin/main while keeping tests. Result: all 15 tests failed, proving the tests are not tautological.

Learnings captured: route reachability is a cross-surface contract. A matrix row is not enough unless every install has the named agent prompt and the generated mirrors validate from the shared source.
